youtube.title: Why Ants Walk in a Perfect Line 🐜 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Ants communicate with chemical signals called pheromones. A scout that finds food lays a scent trail on the way home, and other ants that smell it follow it and reinforce it with their own scent. The stronger the trail, the more ants join the line.
